intent: Searchable command menu for quick actions.
useWhen: Searchable actions and quick jumps: many items, recent items or async results
Command palette — kit Button (or ⌘K) opens kit Modal with Command inside
Which one: if people type to find it, use Command. If they act on one thing, use DropdownMenu. If they pick a value to save, use Select.
doNotUseWhen: Actions from a button — use DropdownMenu
Overlay chrome — compose Modal; do not add CommandDialog

items.label: string
items.description: string? subtle text after the label, one line with an ellipsis; search matches it
items.keywords: string[]? extra words search matches, not shown

groups.note: Each group has optional heading and a required items array. Item icon: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element. Recent items are a plain group with heading "Recent".

label.note: Accessible name on the combobox input

loading.note: Async results on the way: a kit Spinner row and aria-busy on the list. Items already passed stay visible.

onAsk.note: (query: string) => void. Adds an Ask Chat row (MessageCircle) at the foot of the list and in the empty state.

requirements: Input is role=combobox with aria-expanded=true, aria-controls the listbox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-activedescendant, and aria-label from label

Items are role=option with aria-selected when highlighted and aria-disabled when disabled. An item with a shortcut sets aria-keyshortcuts for a chord (e.g. Shift+Meta+P); a sequence such as G I is read as "G then I"
Group headings are visible text in sentence case (no text-transform); inside a kit Modal, Command drops its own frame and the Modal card is the only one
Shortcut chips are Geist Mono, one chip per key, and aria-hidden
A polite live region reads the result count (resultCount label) after each search
The key footer (↑↓ navigate, ↵ open, Esc close) is aria-hidden; Esc hints show only inside a kit Modal
Rows are lg (40px) with a bg tray highlight and 4px radius, the same item anatomy as DropdownMenu
Placement: Command stays put. It always opens in a kit Modal, so it never flips or floats
built-in labels (navigate, openItem, close, resultCount) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default
loading sets aria-busy on the listbox and shows kit Spinner (role=status)
The onAsk row is a role=option at the end of the list, reachable with the arrows like any item

doNot: Do not invent CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandSeparator, CommandShortcut, or CommandDialog
Do not wrap the search field in Field — Command owns its input
Do not use kit Input (uncontrolled) for the query
Do not use cmdk or extra dependencies
Do not close itself — compose Modal for an overlay
snippet:
<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" iconStart="Search" onClick={open} />
<Modal open={open} title="Command menu" onClose={close}>
  <Command groups={groups} onSelect={close} />
</Modal>
